# Realm Chancery & Tax Audit (《中枢文书与度支核查法案》)
oe_v240_pc_crown_chancery_audit = {
	type = country
	estate = crown_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.04
	}

	potential = {
		oe_v240_is_custom_parliament_type = yes
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v240_pc_mod_crown_chancery_audit }
	}

	chance = {
		add = 6
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
		add = 4
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 8
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v240_pc_mod_crown_chancery_audit years = 10 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}
